verdict: Yes, with a clear design point of view. Angrakhaa pitched contemporary Indian clothing on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Indo-western and modern ethnic wear is a large market, but crowded, so your cuts and fabrics need to be recognisable at a glance.
angle: Young buyers want Indian wear they can wear to work, weddings and college, not just festivals. Modern cuts on traditional fabrics sell well on Instagram. Weddings and festivals bring most sales, so plan collections and production months ahead.

faq_extra.q: How much does it cost to start an ethnic wear brand?
faq_extra.a: A small collection of 8–12 designs made through a contract tailor or workshop usually needs ₹2–6 lakh including samples, a photoshoot and launch marketing.
